verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on 2 Kings 23

Covenant compared with Mizpah and Shechem (Wiseman); kemarim priests (Clarke); horses of the sun attested in Assyrian and Aramean sources (Patterson and Austel); Bethel reform possible because Assyria was weak; 1 Kgs 13:1–2 fulfilled; Passover; 23:29 "went to the aid of the king of Assyria" (NKJV) — Assyria allied with Egypt against Babylon; Josiah shot by archers after ignoring Necho's warning (2 Chr 35:20–25); place Hadad-rimmon (Clarke, Zech 12:11); Jehoahaz = Shallum, a throne name, primogeniture overridden (Wiseman); Jehoiakim's palace by forced labour (Wiseman)
